episodes.title: The Almighty Farming Tool
episodes.summary: Hikaru won't waste his second chance at life; he will focus on what truly matters. And so, he builds a new home with his own two hands.

episodes.title: The First Villager
episodes.summary: As the weeks turn into months, Hiraku's loneliness grows. He thought he desired a life of solitude, but his wish for companionship grows stronger by the day.

episodes.title: More and More New Roommates
episodes.summary: Hiraku and Lu begin their new life together, unaware of the visitors who will soon arrive at their household.

episodes.title: Waterways Make Life Feel Complete
episodes.summary: Now that they've secured a reliable water source, they can start a rice paddy and build a bathhouse.

episodes.title: Curry and Surviving the Winter
episodes.summary: With their homestead completed, they turn their focus to food preparation and just in time; Winter is coming.

episodes.title: This Is a Village
episodes.summary: A surprise attack would have shattered their peaceful lives were it not for the almighty farming tool. As word spreads, their home blooms into a village.

episodes.title: A Hospitable Heart
episodes.summary: Hikaru realizes the importance of diplomacy when the demon lord and the dragons establish contact with the Great Tree Village.

episodes.title: The Researcher and the Two Princesses
episodes.summary: They say civilization started because of alcohol. In the Great Tree Village's case, it instigates a misunderstanding between dragons.

episodes.title: The Merchant and the Dragon
episodes.summary: Hiraku's offhand comment leads to a series of events that end with a merchant setting up a trade deal with The Great Tree Village.

episodes.title: Princess Yuri
episodes.summary: Spurred by her followers, the demon lord's daughter attempts to invade the Great Tree Village. "Attempts" being the keyword.

episodes.title: Everyday Life, and the Progenitor
episodes.summary: News of the impending birth thrills the villagers, but they aren't the only ones interested in the good news.

episodes.title: Birth
episodes.summary: Hiraku's second chance was just the beginning. As he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.

episodes.title: The Story So Far
episodes.summary: New residents mean building new homes. There's just one problem: regular houses do not fit the needs of minotaurs and centaurs.

episodes.title: New Residents
episodes.summary: A change of plans is in order. If the current village can't support the new residents, the solution is simple: build more villages.

episodes.title: Winter
episodes.summary: The Great Tree Village experiences another winter.

episodes.title: Martial Arts Competition
episodes.summary: What better way to mark a celebration than with a martial arts competition?

episodes.title: Another Peaceful Day
episodes.summary: From curing an illness to cultivating new crops to even Mountain Elves curating Hiraku's favor, life in the Great Tree Village is never dull.

episodes.title: Fine Day for Visitors
episodes.summary: Hiraku has his hands full as mayor. Not only is he tasked with a series of angelic trials, but he must also mediate a draconic relationship.

episodes.title: Hot Spring Expedition
episodes.summary: A hot springs expedition quickly gets out of hand.

episodes.title: More Hot Spring Expedition
episodes.summary: They've dealt with the Lord of Death. Now they need to decide what to do with the black stones.

episodes.title: Return to Ordinary
episodes.summary: With the problem of the black rocks finally resolved, Hiraku and his friends held a feast in the Great Tree Village to celebrate their hard work. Problems in other areas were also being resolved, and a peaceful time had returned to the village for the first time in a while. Meanwhile, a black cat that had appeared seemingly out of nowhere settled in the village, and Hiraku and his friends began to watch over it. On the other hand, the mountain elves worked on developing new tools, going through a process of trial and error. There were many setbacks, but their efforts gradually took shape, enriching the lives of the villagers.

episodes.title: Festivities and Fuushu's Gratitude
episodes.summary: A new skiing competition is held as part of the autumn festival, keeping Hiraku and his friends extremely busy from preparation to the actual event. The villagers each showcase their skiing skills in their own way, and the competition becomes a lively and exciting event. Afterwards, peaceful days continue in the village, celebrating the growth of the children, but with the help of Husch, new settlers arrive, and life expands even further. While supporting the settlers who are bewildered by their unfamiliar environment, they gradually adapt to their new lives.

episodes.title: Castle in the Air
episodes.summary: As the flying castle approaches the Great Tree Village, Hiraku and his companions begin their operation to subdue it. Splitting into upper and lower groups, they infiltrate the castle, fighting off monsters while searching for a way to control it. Hiraku also joins the exploration, examining the dilapidated buildings and strange structures. As he continues his investigation, he notices an obviously unnatural dead end and mechanism, prompting him to step into a hidden space beyond. There, a new clue leading to the castle's secrets awaits.

episodes.title: A Village For All
episodes.summary: With the problems at Taiyo Castle resolved, it is decided that the area will be accepted as the new village, Shinomura. Hiraku and his friends work on improving the living environment, cultivating fields, and improving crops, gradually settling into life at the castle. As interaction with the other villages becomes more active, their lively daily life expands even further. Eventually, Hiraku proposes raising a common flag to show that the growing group of friends are all living in the same place. Amidst a grand feast where residents from all the villages gather, new connections are forged.
